question: Pusarla Venkata Sindhu won silver medal in badminton in which Olympics Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rio 2016**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pusarla Venkata Sindhu** won the silver medal in badminton at the **Rio 2016** Olympic Games.
 
• She became the first Indian woman to win an Olympic silver medal in badminton.
